title: U Mass - Hind Limb Ischemia
author: Mark Kelly
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.56jg9cn

steps.title: Administer Pre-surgical Analgesics
steps.instruction: Approximately 30 minutes prior to the surgical procedure, administer subcutaneous (S.C.) injections of Buprenorphine and Meloxicam.

substeps.instruction: Inject Buprenorphine at 0.05mg/kg
Inject Meloxicam at 5mg/kg

steps.title: Anesthetize Mice
steps.instruction: Anesthetize the mice using one of the following regimens and monitor depth of anesthesia via respiratory rate and toe or ear pinches.

substeps.instruction: Option 1: Ketamine (80-100mg/kg) and Xylazine (5-20mg/kg)
Option 2: Isoflurane 1-3%

steps.title: Prepare Surgical Site
steps.instruction: Prepare the animal and surgical field using aseptic techniques.

substeps.instruction: Place mice supine on a heating pad
Remove hair from 0.5 cm above the elbow to 0.5 cm below the knee joint
Prep the surgical field with 70% isopropanol and Betadine solution, then drape the mice
Apply ointment to the animal's eyes
Confirm depth of anesthesia with a toe pinch

steps.title: Perform Hind Limb Ischemia Surgery
steps.instruction: Execute the surgical procedure to ligate the femoral artery. Choose between the standard or severe ischemic model.

substeps.instruction: Make a skin incision from the medial thigh towards the knee
Blunt dissect subcutaneous fat tissue to reveal the underlying femoral artery
Pierce the membranous femoral sheath to expose the neurovascular bundle
Standard Model: Dissect and separate the femoral artery from the femoral vein and nerve from the inguinal ligament to the epigastrica
Severe Model: Dissect and separate the femoral artery, femoral vein, and nerve from the inguinal ligament to the sapheno-popliteal bifurcation
Standard Model Ligation: Place two 7-0 silk sutures around the femoral artery 2mm apart, ligate, and divide the artery between the sutures
Severe Model Ligation: Ligate the femoral artery using 7-0 silk sutures between the superficial epigastric artery and the sapheno-popliteal bifurcation

steps.title: Close Incision and Hydrate
steps.instruction: Close the surgical site and provide subcutaneous fluids to prevent dehydration.

substeps.instruction: Close the skin incision using 6-0 Prolene suture
Inject 0.5 ml of 0.9% NaCl subcutaneously

steps.title: Post-operative Care and Monitoring
steps.instruction: Provide post-surgical analgesia and monitor animal health.

substeps.instruction: Administer Buprenorphine (0.05mg/kg) every 12 hours for 72 hours post-op
Administer Meloxicam (5mg/kg) every 24 hours for 72 hours post-op
Monitor mice 2x daily for the first 5 days post-surgery
Monitor mice at least 3x per week thereafter
